| # Reliability parameters of the safety function "external stop switch" {#reliability-parameters-of-the-safety-function-external-stop-switch-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                                                                         |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

For the safety function 2 (external stop switch), the mean time to dangerous failure (MTTFD) and diagnostic coverage (DC) for the maximum number of safe outputs with the temperature profiles T1, T2 and T3 are given in the following table.

 

 

+-------------------------+-----+-----------------------+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Function group          | No. | MTTFD (year)          | DC(%) | Explanation                                                                                                                                                                           |
|                         |     +-------+-------+-------+       |                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|                         |     | T1    | T2    | T3    |       |                                                                                                                                                                                       |
+=========================+=====+=======+=======+=======+=======+=======================================================================================================================================================================================+
| Channel 1                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
+-------------------------+-----+-------+-------+-------+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Power supply            | K10 | 453   | 338   | 192   | 95    |  -                                                                                                                                                                                    |
+-------------------------+-----+-------+-------+-------+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Microcontroller         | K11 | 1499  | 1160  | 691   | 98    |  -                                                                                                                                                                                    |
+-------------------------+-----+-------+-------+-------+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Output control device   | K15 | 2053  | 1421  | 741   | 94    | MTTFD values are valid for a single output control devices. For safe output configurations with more than one output control device, MTTFD values shall be considered multiple times. |
+-------------------------+-----+-------+-------+-------+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| High-side power outputs | K16 | 5065  | 3490  | 1810  | 99    | MTTFD values are valid for a single HS. For safe output configurations with more than one HS, MTTFD values shall be considered multiple times.                                        |
+-------------------------+-----+-------+-------+-------+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Channel 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
+-------------------------+-----+-------+-------+-------+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Output enable           | K13 | 27963 | 21133 | 12225 | 98    |  -                                                                                                                                                                                    |
+-------------------------+-----+-------+-------+-------+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Shut-OFF path           | K14 | 24788 | 20958 | 14305 | 98    |  -                                                                                                                                                                                    |
+-------------------------+-----+-------+-------+-------+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Low-side power outputs  | K17 | 3557  | 2511  | 1338  | 99    | MTTFD values are valid for a single LS. For safe output configurations with more than one LS, MTTFD values shall be considered multiple times.                                        |
+-------------------------+-----+-------+-------+-------+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
